title: Journal entries and account groups
intro: Post financial transactions with journal entries, and organize the chart using account groups. Day-to-day cash expenses at closing are separate from these GL journals.

sections.title: Journal entries
steps: Create balanced debit/credit lines for the transaction.
Save to post into the general ledger (approval rules may apply).
sections.caption: Journal entries tab.

sections.title: Account groups
sections.intro: Groups help organize accounts for statements and reporting rollups.
steps: Create groups that match your reporting structure.
Assign accounts to groups from the chart or group forms.
sections.caption: Account groups tab.
